title: Where noise must go to change the idea (iteration 4, plan gen_plan_experiment_2_idx3)
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B rev b968826d9c46dd6066d109eabc6255188de91218, thinking off, T=1.0, top-p 1, no top-k, max_new 1024, fence stop
precision_rule: total VRAM >= 19.5 GiB -> bf16; Ada/Hopper with < 19.5 GiB -> exp17 FP8 W8A8 path; Ampere < 19.5 GiB -> FP8 weight-only. Every arm uses one precision.

sites.S0: blocks 12-23, task-spec positions S, target alpha*n_S[l,k]
sites.S3: blocks 12-23, generated input positions 1-32 (vs a teacher-forced shadow row), alpha*n_G[l]
sites.S5: blocks 24-35, S, alpha*n_S[l,k] (block-35 edit is a no-op)
sites.S1E/S2E: S1/S2 with the target multiplied by the energy-matching scalar c

units: n = ||h_ban - h_twin|| per block and position, mean over W1-W5 (S, R) or per template (COND); per-position ban units are the primary dose convention
direction: u(t,w,k) = normalise(PCG64(stable_seed('PN4',t,w,k)).standard_normal(4096)) float32, shared by every site, dose and boundary arm of slot (t,w,k)
uniforms: exp17 u_stream(task, template, k) (stable_seed(task, template, k)), shared by every arm
batch: 20 rows of one (task, template), fixed shape; finished rows fed <|im_end|>
engine_check_criteria: REPRODUCED if JS(our composition, screen composition) <= the 95th percentile of a template-resampling null (JS between two template-stratified bootstrap resamples of the pooled programs at matched sizes) AND |off-default share difference| <= 0.15; run on T03 rand_9002 alpha 1 and T2 rand_9004 alpha 1 (N=50 each, k 0-9) under the screen's uniforms and units; failure is reported as precision/engine sensitivity, the run proceeds

hardware.precision_rule: VRAM >= 19.5 GiB -> bf16; Ada/Hopper < 19.5 GiB -> exp17 FP8 W8A8; Ampere < 19.5 GiB -> FP8 weight-only
hardware.quant: fp8_e4m3_w8a8_dynamic(per-output-channel weight scales, per-token activation scales; lm_head/embeddings/norms bf16)
